newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: CZECH FINMIN SETS 13-WK T-BILL AUCTION FOR THURS.
newsitem.headline: CZECH FINMIN SETS 13-WK T-BILL AUCTION FOR THURS.

text.p: The Czech Finance Ministry on Monday said it would auction a six billion crown tranche of 13-week treasury bills on Thursday.
Maximum yield in the Dutch-style auction has been set at 12.25 percent.

In the last auction of similar T-bills on Janury 16, gross yield hit 11.9 billion crowns. The auction of five billion crowns worth of bills was heavily oversubscribed with bids totalling 19.894 billion crowns.
